metadata.description: 250 curated scientific constants with measurable experimental data for Z² derivation testing

topics.name: CKM matrix element V_ud
topics.description: Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa quark mixing matrix element connecting up and down quarks. Governs beta decay rates and reflects the geometry of flavor space.
topics.physical_context: The CKM matrix describes quark flavor mixing in weak interactions. V_ud is the largest element, close to unity, suggesting a near-diagonal structure.
topics.z2_hint: The value 0.97373 is close to cos(θ_C) where θ_C is the Cabibbo angle. May relate to geometric angle in flavor space.

topics.name: CKM matrix element V_us
topics.description: CKM matrix element for up-strange quark mixing. Also known as the Cabibbo angle sine: sin(θ_C) ≈ 0.225.
topics.physical_context: Controls the rate of strangeness-changing weak decays like K → πlν. The Cabibbo angle θ_C ≈ 13° defines this mixing.
topics.z2_hint: sin(θ_C) ≈ 0.225 might relate to a fundamental geometric angle. Consider 3/13 ≈ 0.231 connection.

topics.name: CKM matrix element V_cb
topics.description: CKM matrix element for charm-bottom quark mixing. Much smaller than V_ud, indicating hierarchical structure.
topics.physical_context: Governs b → c transitions. The small value reflects the mass hierarchy between quark generations.
topics.z2_hint: V_cb ≈ 0.042 might be related to 1/Z or 1/Z² expressions where Z = √(32π/3).

topics.name: CKM matrix element V_ub
topics.description: CKM matrix element for up-bottom quark mixing. Smallest element, crucial for CP violation.
topics.physical_context: Enables b → u transitions and direct CP violation. Ratio V_ub/V_cb ≈ 0.09 is a key observable.
topics.z2_hint: The ratio V_ub/V_cb might have geometric significance in flavor space.

topics.name: Jarlskog invariant J
topics.description: Rephasing-invariant measure of CP violation in the quark sector. Determines matter-antimatter asymmetry from CKM.
topics.physical_context: J = Im(V_ud V_cb* V_ub* V_cd) is the unique invariant measuring CP violation. Maximum possible value is 1/(6√3) ≈ 0.096.
topics.z2_hint: J/J_max ≈ 3.3×10^-4 might relate to Z² geometric suppression factors.

topics.name: CP violation phase δ_CKM
topics.description: CP-violating phase in the CKM matrix, approximately 66 degrees. Source of quark sector CP violation.
topics.physical_context: The phase δ appears in the standard CKM parameterization. Non-zero δ is required for CP violation.
topics.z2_hint: δ ≈ 66° might relate to arccos(Z-related fraction) or arctan expressions.

topics.name: PMNS matrix element sin²θ_12
topics.description: Solar neutrino mixing angle. Governs ν_e ↔ ν_μ transitions in matter (MSW effect).
topics.physical_context: θ_12 ≈ 33.5° is the solar mixing angle, measured via reactor and solar neutrino experiments.
topics.z2_hint: sin²θ_12 ≈ 0.307 might relate to 4/13 ≈ 0.308 or other Z²-derived fractions.

topics.name: PMNS matrix element sin²θ_23
topics.description: Atmospheric neutrino mixing angle. Near-maximal mixing governs ν_μ ↔ ν_τ oscillations.
topics.physical_context: θ_23 ≈ 47° is close to 45° (maximal mixing). Atmospheric neutrino anomaly provides the measurement.
topics.z2_hint: Near-maximal mixing suggests geometric origin. sin²θ_23 ≈ 1/2 might be exact in some limit.

topics.name: PMNS matrix element sin²θ_13
topics.description: Reactor neutrino mixing angle. Smallest PMNS mixing parameter, enables leptonic CP violation.
topics.physical_context: θ_13 ≈ 8.5° was measured in 2012 by Daya Bay. Non-zero value opens door to leptonic CP violation.
topics.z2_hint: sin²θ_13 ≈ 0.022 might relate to (2Z - 3°)² or similar Z-dependent angle formula.

topics.name: Neutrino mass squared difference Δm²_21
topics.description: Solar mass squared splitting in eV². Determines solar neutrino oscillation frequency.
topics.physical_context: Δm²_21 = m²_2 - m²_1 ≈ 7.5×10^-5 eV² governs the MSW effect in the Sun.
topics.z2_hint: The ratio Δm²_21/Δm²_31 ≈ 0.03 might have Z² geometric significance.

topics.name: Neutrino mass squared difference |Δm²_31|
topics.description: Atmospheric mass squared splitting in eV². Sign determines mass ordering (normal vs inverted).
topics.physical_context: |Δm²_31| ≈ 2.5×10^-3 eV² governs atmospheric neutrino oscillations. Current hint favors normal ordering.
topics.z2_hint: Δm²_31/Δm²_21 ≈ 32.6 is close to Z² ≈ 33.5. Investigate this ratio.

topics.name: Top quark mass
topics.description: Pole mass of the top quark in GeV. Heaviest known elementary particle.
topics.physical_context: The top quark mass is special: m_t ≈ v/√2 where v is the Higgs VEV. This suggests Yukawa coupling near unity.
topics.z2_hint: m_t ≈ 172.5 GeV. Ratio m_t/m_W ≈ 2.14 might relate to 2 + Z/Z² or similar.

topics.name: Top to bottom mass ratio
topics.description: Ratio of top quark mass to bottom quark mass (running masses at M_Z scale).
topics.physical_context: m_t/m_b ≈ 41.3 reflects the Yukawa hierarchy in the third generation. Bottom mass is ≈ 4.18 GeV at M_Z.
topics.z2_hint: m_t/m_b ≈ 41.3 is close to Z² + 8 ≈ 41.5. Investigate Z² connection.

topics.name: W boson mass
topics.description: Mass of the W± gauge boson in GeV. Mediates charged weak interactions.
topics.physical_context: M_W = g·v/2 where g is SU(2) coupling and v is Higgs VEV. The M_W/M_Z ratio relates to sin²θ_W.
topics.z2_hint: M_W ≈ 80.37 GeV. Ratio M_W/M_Z ≈ 0.8815 and sin²θ_W = 1 - (M_W/M_Z)² might be Z² derivable.

topics.name: Z boson width
topics.description: Total decay width of the Z boson in GeV. Determines Z lifetime and invisible width.
topics.physical_context: Γ_Z counts light neutrino species via invisible width Γ_inv ≈ 499 MeV, giving N_ν = 2.9840 ± 0.0082.
topics.z2_hint: Γ_Z/M_Z ≈ 0.0274 or Γ_Z in units of some reference might show Z² pattern.

topics.name: Higgs boson mass
topics.description: Mass of the Higgs boson in GeV. Discovered at LHC in 2012.
topics.physical_context: M_H = √(2λ)·v where λ is Higgs self-coupling and v = 246 GeV. This implies λ ≈ 0.129.
topics.z2_hint: M_H ≈ 125.2 GeV. Ratio M_H/v ≈ 0.509 might relate to 1/2 or Z²-derived value.

topics.name: Higgs quartic coupling λ
topics.description: Higgs self-coupling constant. Determines Higgs potential shape and vacuum stability.
topics.physical_context: λ = M_H²/(2v²) ≈ 0.129. Running of λ to high scales determines vacuum stability/metastability.
topics.z2_hint: λ ≈ 0.129 is close to 4/Z² ≈ 0.119. Investigate 4/Z² or similar expressions.

topics.name: Strong coupling at M_Z
topics.description: QCD coupling constant α_s evaluated at the Z pole mass.
topics.physical_context: α_s(M_Z) determines the strength of strong interactions at electroweak scale. Running gives α_s(1 GeV) ≈ 0.5.
topics.z2_hint: α_s ≈ 0.118 is very close to 4/Z² ≈ 0.1194. Strong candidate for Z² derivation.

topics.name: QCD Lambda parameter
topics.description: QCD scale Λ_QCD in MeV (5 flavor, MS-bar scheme). Sets the scale of confinement.
topics.physical_context: Λ_QCD marks where α_s becomes strong. Below this scale, quarks confine into hadrons.
topics.z2_hint: Λ_QCD ≈ 217 MeV. Ratio Λ_QCD/m_π ≈ 1.6 or Λ_QCD/f_π ≈ 2.3 might show patterns.

topics.name: Pion decay constant f_π
topics.description: Weak decay constant of the charged pion in MeV. Defines chiral symmetry breaking scale.
topics.physical_context: f_π parameterizes ⟨0|A_μ|π⟩. Related to quark condensate and chiral perturbation theory.
topics.z2_hint: f_π ≈ 92 MeV. Ratio f_π/Λ_QCD or f_π/m_π ≈ 0.66 might have significance.

topics.name: Kaon decay constant f_K
topics.description: Weak decay constant of the charged kaon in MeV.
topics.physical_context: f_K/f_π ≈ 1.198 measures SU(3) flavor breaking. Used to extract V_us from K_l2 decays.
topics.z2_hint: f_K/f_π ≈ 1.198 might relate to 1 + 1/Z or similar expressions.

topics.name: Proton mass
topics.description: Rest mass of the proton in MeV/c². One of the most precisely measured masses.
topics.physical_context: Most of proton mass comes from QCD binding energy, not quark masses. m_p ≈ 3×Λ_QCD.
topics.z2_hint: m_p/m_e ≈ 1836.15 might have Z² structure. Also m_p/Λ_QCD ≈ 4.3.

topics.name: Neutron-proton mass difference
topics.description: Mass difference m_n - m_p in MeV. Critical for nuclear stability and nucleosynthesis.
topics.physical_context: Δm ≈ 1.293 MeV allows neutron beta decay and determines nuclear binding competition.
topics.z2_hint: Δm/m_e ≈ 2.53 or Δm in units of other scales might show Z² patterns.

topics.name: Proton charge radius
topics.description: Root-mean-square charge radius of the proton in femtometers.
topics.physical_context: The 'proton radius puzzle' was resolved by muonic hydrogen measurements. r_p = 0.8409 fm.
topics.z2_hint: r_p ≈ 0.84 fm. Ratio r_p/ℏc×m_p or dimensionless combinations might be derivable.

topics.name: Neutron lifetime
topics.description: Mean lifetime of the free neutron in seconds. Measures Fermi coupling and V_ud.
topics.physical_context: τ_n depends on G_F, V_ud, and phase space. Tension between beam and bottle measurements.
topics.z2_hint: τ_n ≈ 878 s. τ_n × m_n in natural units or other combinations might show patterns.

topics.name: Muon anomalous magnetic moment
topics.description: Anomalous magnetic moment a_μ = (g-2)/2 of the muon.
topics.physical_context: a_μ tests the entire Standard Model. Current 5.1σ tension with theory may indicate new physics.
topics.z2_hint: a_μ ≈ α/(2π) + corrections. The value 0.001165... might have geometric structure.

topics.name: Electron anomalous magnetic moment
topics.description: Anomalous magnetic moment a_e = (g-2)/2 of the electron. Most precise QED test.
topics.physical_context: a_e = α/(2π) - 0.328(α/π)² + ... Determines the fine structure constant.
topics.z2_hint: a_e ≈ α/(2π). The deviation from this leading term might show Z² structure.

topics.name: Fermi coupling constant
topics.description: Fermi constant G_F in GeV^-2. Strength of weak interactions at low energy.
topics.physical_context: G_F = (√2/8) × g²/M_W² = 1/(√2 v²) where v is Higgs VEV.
topics.z2_hint: G_F × M_W² ≈ 0.0375 might relate to Z² geometric factors.

topics.name: Planck mass
topics.description: Planck mass M_P = √(ℏc/G) in GeV. Scale where quantum gravity becomes strong.
topics.physical_context: M_P sets the hierarchy problem: why is M_H << M_P? Ratio M_P/M_W ≈ 10^17.
topics.z2_hint: M_P/M_W ≈ 1.5×10^17. The logarithm ln(M_P/M_W) ≈ 39.5 might relate to Z² expressions.

topics.name: Cosmological constant density
topics.description: Dark energy density parameter Ω_Λ. Fraction of universe's energy in cosmological constant.
topics.physical_context: Ω_Λ ≈ 0.685 dominates late universe, causing accelerated expansion. Why this value?
topics.z2_hint: Ω_Λ = 13/19 ≈ 0.6842 is a known Z² prediction. Verify against latest data.

topics.name: Matter density parameter
topics.description: Total matter density Ω_m = Ω_b + Ω_c. Includes baryons and cold dark matter.
topics.physical_context: Ω_m ≈ 0.315 with Ω_b ≈ 0.049 baryonic. CDM dominates by factor of 5.
topics.z2_hint: Ω_m = 6/19 ≈ 0.3158 complements Ω_Λ = 13/19. Flat universe: Ω_m + Ω_Λ = 1.

topics.name: Baryon density parameter
topics.description: Baryon density Ω_b. Fraction of matter that is ordinary baryonic matter.
topics.physical_context: Ω_b h² ≈ 0.0224 from BBN and CMB. Only ~5% of universe is baryonic.
topics.z2_hint: Ω_b ≈ 0.049. Ratio Ω_b/Ω_m ≈ 0.156 might have Z² geometric meaning.

topics.name: Hubble constant H_0
topics.description: Current expansion rate of the universe in km/s/Mpc.
topics.physical_context: H_0 tension: Planck gives 67.4, local measurements give ~73. 5σ discrepancy.
topics.z2_hint: H_0 ≈ 67.4 or Hubble time t_H = 1/H_0 ≈ 14.5 Gyr might relate to Z² combinations.

topics.name: Spectral index n_s
topics.description: Scalar spectral index of primordial perturbations. Deviation from scale invariance.
topics.physical_context: n_s < 1 confirms red-tilted spectrum from slow-roll inflation. Deviation 1 - n_s ≈ 0.035.
topics.z2_hint: n_s ≈ Z/6 ≈ 0.965 is a candidate Z² formula. Verify precision.

topics.name: Scalar amplitude A_s
topics.description: Amplitude of primordial scalar perturbations at pivot scale k = 0.05 Mpc^-1.
topics.physical_context: A_s ≈ 2×10^-9 sets the overall amplitude of CMB anisotropies. Related to inflation energy scale.
topics.z2_hint: ln(10^10 A_s) ≈ 3.044. This logarithm might have Z² significance.

topics.name: Tensor-to-scalar ratio r
topics.description: Upper limit on tensor-to-scalar ratio r < 0.036 at 95% CL.
topics.physical_context: r measures primordial gravitational waves. Upper bound constrains inflation models.
topics.z2_hint: If r is measured, r_true might relate to Z² geometric factors.

topics.name: Optical depth to reionization τ
topics.description: CMB optical depth to Thomson scattering from reionization.
topics.physical_context: τ ≈ 0.054 implies reionization around z ≈ 7-8. First stars ionized intergalactic hydrogen.
topics.z2_hint: τ ≈ 0.054 or 1-exp(-τ) might have Z² geometric structure.

topics.name: CMB temperature T_0
topics.description: Present-day CMB blackbody temperature in Kelvin.
topics.physical_context: T_0 = 2.7255 K is the most precise blackbody measurement. T ∝ (1+z) redshifts with expansion.
topics.z2_hint: T_0/T_Planck ≈ 1.9×10^-32 or T_0 in other units might show patterns.

topics.name: Age of the universe
topics.description: Age of the universe in billions of years (Gyr) from ΛCDM fit.
topics.physical_context: t_0 ≈ 13.8 Gyr from CMB + BAO + H_0. Consistent with oldest stellar ages.
topics.z2_hint: t_0 ≈ Z + 8 Gyr is a candidate formula. Also t_0 × H_0 ≈ 0.95.

topics.name: Recombination redshift
topics.description: Redshift of last scattering surface when CMB was released.
topics.physical_context: z_* ≈ 1090 corresponds to T ≈ 3000 K when hydrogen became neutral.
topics.z2_hint: z_* ≈ 1090 or ln(z_*) ≈ 7.0 might relate to Z² expressions.

topics.name: Equality redshift
topics.description: Redshift of matter-radiation equality.
topics.physical_context: z_eq ≈ 3400 when ρ_matter = ρ_radiation. Determines CMB peak structure.
topics.z2_hint: z_eq ≈ 3400 or z_eq/z_* ≈ 3.1 might have Z² significance.

topics.name: Sound horizon at recombination
topics.description: Comoving sound horizon r_s at recombination in Mpc. BAO standard ruler.
topics.physical_context: r_s ≈ 144 Mpc sets the BAO scale seen in galaxy surveys.
topics.z2_hint: r_s × H_0 ≈ 9.7 or r_s in other units might show patterns.

topics.name: Baryon-photon ratio η
topics.description: Baryon-to-photon number density ratio η = n_b/n_γ.
topics.physical_context: η ≈ 6×10^-10 from BBN and CMB. Sets primordial element abundances.
topics.z2_hint: η × 10^10 ≈ 6.12 might relate to Z² fractions.

topics.name: Sigma_8 matter fluctuation amplitude
topics.description: RMS matter fluctuation in 8 h^-1 Mpc spheres.
topics.physical_context: σ_8 measures clustering strength. Tension with weak lensing (σ_8 ≈ 0.76).
topics.z2_hint: σ_8 ≈ 0.811 or 30/37 ≈ 0.811 might be Z²-derived.

topics.name: Rydberg constant
topics.description: Rydberg constant R_∞ in m^-1. Fundamental atomic transition scale.
topics.physical_context: R_∞ = α²m_e c/(2h) determines hydrogen spectral lines. Most precise atomic constant.
topics.z2_hint: R_∞ in units of m^-1 or combined with other constants might show Z² structure.

topics.name: Bohr radius
topics.description: Bohr radius a_0 = ℏ/(m_e c α) in meters. Natural atomic length scale.
topics.physical_context: a_0 ≈ 0.529 Å sets the size of hydrogen atom. a_0 × α = ℏ/(m_e c).
topics.z2_hint: a_0 × R_∞ = α²/2 ≈ 2.66×10^-5 might have Z² geometric meaning.

topics.name: Hydrogen 1S-2S transition frequency
topics.description: 1S-2S two-photon transition frequency in hydrogen in Hz. One of most precise measurements.
topics.physical_context: This transition is forbidden E1, making it narrow. Used for optical clock and R_∞ determination.
topics.z2_hint: ν(1S-2S)/R_∞ c or related combinations might show Z² patterns.

topics.name: Lamb shift in hydrogen
topics.description: 2S_1/2 - 2P_1/2 Lamb shift in hydrogen in MHz. QED vacuum polarization effect.
topics.physical_context: Lamb shift ≈ 1058 MHz was first QED triumph. Measures vacuum fluctuation effects.
topics.z2_hint: Lamb shift / (α³ × Ry) or similar combinations might be Z²-derivable.

topics.name: Muonium hyperfine splitting
topics.description: Ground state hyperfine splitting of muonium (μ⁺e⁻) in Hz.
topics.physical_context: Muonium is a pure leptonic atom. HFS tests bound-state QED without nuclear structure.
topics.z2_hint: Ratio to hydrogen HFS ≈ 3.183 might relate to m_μ/m_e or Z² combinations.

topics.name: Positronium 1S-2S transition
topics.description: 1S-2S transition frequency in positronium (e⁺e⁻) in MHz.
topics.physical_context: Positronium is purely leptonic. Tests QED with no nuclear structure corrections.
topics.z2_hint: Ratio to hydrogen 1S-2S ≈ 1/2 due to reduced mass. Any deviation might be Z² related.

topics.name: Hydrogen ground state hyperfine splitting
topics.description: Ground state hyperfine splitting of hydrogen (21 cm line) in MHz.
topics.physical_context: The famous 21 cm line. ν_HFS ≈ (8/3)α²g_p(m_e/m_p)R_∞c.
topics.z2_hint: ν_HFS/(α² R_∞ c) might have Z²-geometric significance.

topics.name: Helium ionization energy
topics.description: First ionization energy of helium in eV.
topics.physical_context: He has highest ionization energy due to 1s² closed shell. I_He/I_H ≈ 1.807.
topics.z2_hint: I_He/Ry ≈ 1.807 might relate to Z² or mass-charge scaling.

topics.name: Lithium ionization energy
topics.description: First ionization energy of lithium in eV.
topics.physical_context: Li is first alkali metal. Low ionization energy due to 2s electron shielding.
topics.z2_hint: I_Li/Ry ≈ 0.396 or I_Li/I_H ≈ 0.396 might have Z² geometric meaning.

topics.name: Cesium D1 line wavelength
topics.description: Wavelength of cesium 6S_1/2 → 6P_1/2 transition in nm.
topics.physical_context: Cs D1 line is used in laser cooling and optical pumping. D1-D2 splitting tests fine structure.
topics.z2_hint: D1/D2 wavelength ratio or in terms of α might show Z² patterns.

topics.name: Rubidium ground state hyperfine splitting
topics.description: ⁸⁷Rb ground state hyperfine splitting in Hz.
topics.physical_context: Rb is commonly used for atomic clocks and cold atom experiments.
topics.z2_hint: Rb HFS/H HFS ≈ 4.81 might relate to nuclear structure + Z² factors.

topics.name: Deuterium binding energy
topics.description: Binding energy of the deuteron (proton-neutron bound state) in MeV.
topics.physical_context: B_d ≈ 2.22 MeV is the only bound np state. Sets scale for nuclear binding.
topics.z2_hint: B_d/m_π ≈ 0.016 or B_d/Λ_QCD might have Z² geometric significance.

topics.name: Alpha particle binding energy
topics.description: Total binding energy of ⁴He nucleus in MeV.
topics.physical_context: B(⁴He) ≈ 28.3 MeV. High B/A ≈ 7.07 MeV explains alpha stability.
topics.z2_hint: B(⁴He)/B_d ≈ 12.7 or B(⁴He)/m_π might relate to Z² expressions.

topics.name: Iron-56 binding energy per nucleon
topics.description: Binding energy per nucleon for ⁵⁶Fe in MeV. Near maximum of binding curve.
topics.physical_context: ⁵⁶Fe is most tightly bound per nucleon. B/A ≈ 8.79 MeV is the nuclear valley minimum.
topics.z2_hint: B/A ≈ Z + 3 MeV is a candidate formula. Verify precision.

topics.name: Nuclear radius constant
topics.description: Constant r_0 in R = r_0 A^(1/3) formula for nuclear radius in fm.
topics.physical_context: r_0 ≈ 1.2-1.3 fm from electron scattering and muonic atoms. Sets nuclear density.
topics.z2_hint: r_0 ≈ 1.25 fm or r_0/ℏc × Λ_QCD might show Z² patterns.

topics.name: Nuclear saturation density
topics.description: Saturation density of nuclear matter ρ_0 in fm⁻³.
topics.physical_context: ρ_0 ≈ 0.16 fm⁻³ ≈ 2.3×10^14 g/cm³. Nuclear density is nearly constant in all nuclei.
topics.z2_hint: ρ_0 × r_0³ or ρ_0 in natural units might have Z² significance.

topics.name: Volume term coefficient a_V
topics.description: Volume term coefficient in semi-empirical mass formula in MeV.
topics.physical_context: a_V ≈ 15.8 MeV represents saturation energy per nucleon. Largest term in SEMF.
topics.z2_hint: a_V ≈ 16 MeV or a_V/m_π might relate to Z² geometric factors.

topics.name: Surface term coefficient a_S
topics.description: Surface term coefficient in semi-empirical mass formula in MeV.
topics.physical_context: a_S ≈ 18.3 MeV accounts for reduced binding at nuclear surface.
topics.z2_hint: a_S/a_V ≈ 1.16 or a_S in terms of nuclear scale might show patterns.

topics.name: Coulomb term coefficient a_C
topics.description: Coulomb term coefficient in semi-empirical mass formula in MeV.
topics.physical_context: a_C ≈ 0.714 MeV. Coulomb repulsion scales as Z²/A^(1/3).
topics.z2_hint: a_C relates to (3/5)(e²/r_0). May have Z² geometric connection.

topics.name: Asymmetry term coefficient a_A
topics.description: Asymmetry (symmetry) term coefficient in SEMF in MeV.
topics.physical_context: a_A ≈ 23 MeV penalizes N≠Z. Related to isospin symmetry of nuclear force.
topics.z2_hint: a_A ≈ 23 MeV or a_A/a_V ≈ 1.47 might have Z² significance.

topics.name: Pairing term coefficient a_P
topics.description: Pairing term coefficient in SEMF in MeV.
topics.physical_context: a_P ≈ 12 MeV accounts for nucleon pairing (like Cooper pairs in superconductors).
topics.z2_hint: a_P ≈ 12 MeV or a_P/a_V might relate to pairing physics and Z².

topics.name: Neutron capture cross section at thermal
topics.description: ¹⁰B thermal neutron capture cross section in barns.
topics.physical_context: High σ(n,α) for ¹⁰B used in neutron detection and therapy.
topics.z2_hint: σ/πr₀² where r₀ is nuclear radius might show geometric patterns.

topics.name: Uranium-235 thermal fission cross section
topics.description: ²³⁵U thermal neutron fission cross section in barns.
topics.physical_context: σ_f(²³⁵U) ≈ 584 b is the key fissile parameter for nuclear reactors.
topics.z2_hint: σ_f in units of nuclear area πR² might relate to geometric factors.

topics.name: BCS superconducting gap ratio
topics.description: Universal ratio 2Δ(0)/(k_B T_c) in weak-coupling BCS theory.
topics.physical_context: BCS predicts 2Δ/kT_c = 3.528 for conventional superconductors. Deviations indicate strong coupling.
topics.z2_hint: 3.528 = 2πe^γ where γ is Euler constant. May have deeper geometric origin.

topics.name: Landau Fermi liquid parameter F_0^s
topics.description: Spin-symmetric Landau parameter F_0^s for liquid ³He at low pressure.
topics.physical_context: F_0^s characterizes quasiparticle interactions. Negative value indicates ferromagnetic tendency.
topics.z2_hint: F_0^s ≈ -3/4 might be an exact ratio with Z² significance.

topics.name: Critical exponent β for 3D Ising
topics.description: Order parameter critical exponent β for 3D Ising universality class.
topics.physical_context: M ~ |T-T_c|^β near phase transition. β_3D = 0.3265 from conformal bootstrap.
topics.z2_hint: β ≈ 5/16 = 0.3125 is close. Exact value might involve Z² geometry.

topics.name: Critical exponent γ for 3D Ising
topics.description: Susceptibility critical exponent γ for 3D Ising universality class.
topics.physical_context: χ ~ |T-T_c|^-γ diverges at phase transition. γ_3D = 1.2372 from conformal bootstrap.
topics.z2_hint: γ ≈ 47/38 ≈ 1.237 might be exact Z²-derived ratio.

topics.name: Critical exponent ν for 3D Ising
topics.description: Correlation length critical exponent ν for 3D Ising universality class.
topics.physical_context: ξ ~ |T-T_c|^-ν diverges at criticality. ν_3D = 0.6300 known to high precision.
topics.z2_hint: ν ≈ 0.63 = 63/100. Might relate to 19/30 ≈ 0.633 or similar fractions.

topics.name: Percolation threshold 3D simple cubic
topics.description: Site percolation threshold p_c for 3D simple cubic lattice.
topics.physical_context: At p_c ≈ 0.3116, infinite cluster first appears. Universal for transport in random media.
topics.z2_hint: p_c ≈ 14/45 ≈ 0.311 might be an exact Z²-derived fraction.

topics.name: Grüneisen parameter for gold
topics.description: Grüneisen parameter γ relating thermal expansion to specific heat for Au.
topics.physical_context: γ_G = αV/(C_V κ) ≈ 3 for many metals. Measures anharmonicity of lattice vibrations.
topics.z2_hint: γ_G ≈ 3 for most metals. Universal value might have Z² geometric origin.

topics.name: Lindemann melting criterion
